name: taxonomic-functional-profiling
description: Profile the taxonomic composition and functional potential of the microbial community. MetaPhlAn uses clade-specific marker genes (approximately 1.1 million markers from 13,500 species) for species-level relative abundance estimation. Kraken2 uses exact k-mer matching against a reference database for fast classification. HUMAnN3 maps reads to UniRef90 gene families and MetaCyc pathways for functional profiling.
